author: The Sconi
title: Community Blood Center schedules two May blood drives in Wisconsin Rapids
text:
The Community Blood Center will host two blood drives in Wisconsin Rapids this May, offering residents an opportunity to support patients across the region, according to an April 30 announcement. The events are scheduled for Monday, May 18 from 2 to 6:30 p.m. and Tuesday, May 19 from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m., both at the former East Junior High School at 311 Lincoln St., in the Music/Band Room. Parking is available at the end of S. Sixth St., across from the baseball diamond.
Organizers say every two seconds someone in the United States needs blood, and a single donation can help provide lifesaving care for multiple people. Appointments are appreciated and can be made by calling (800) 280‑4102.
Aspirus Langlade Hospital operates as a nonprofit organization within the Aspirus Health system according to the official website . The hospital supports regional healthcare as part of this network according to the official website .
Aspirus Langlade Hospital maintains its facility at 112 East Fifth Avenue in Antigo, Wisconsin according to the official website , and is affiliated with Aspirus Health—a nonprofit community-focused health system according to the official website . It functions as a full-service medical center providing round-the-clock care and various specialties according to the official website .
Aspirus Langlade Hospital is based in Antigo, Wisconsin, connecting local residents with broader healthcare resources through its network according to the official website .
